[RARC.4.7] **Scope exclusion: in-memory IPC.** This policy applies
to artifacts that persist across process boundaries in time
(files) or across release boundaries. Live IPC between sibling
tiers is the integrator's transport, carrying whatever the
integrator encodes ([RARC.3.3.3]) — the engine defines no format
there, so there is no version to refuse.
